description: The counts of an alignment of any number of sequences as Bio.Align's alignment.counts(scoring): aligned letters, identities, mismatches, positives (with a substitution matrix: letters with a positive score), and the gaps split by side (left / internal / right), direction (insertion = a gap in the target, deletion = a gap in the query) and opened / extended; the counts add up over every pair of sequences. Scoring: none (letter equality); wildcard (letters equal to it are neither identities nor mismatches); matrix (name or text; adds the substitution score); or an aligner (matchScore / mismatchScore / matrix / wildcard / gapScoresJson as in pairwise_aligner) which adds the gap score and the total score. gapScoresJson: a JSON object of Biopython gap-score properties (open_gap_score, extend_gap_score, gap_score, left_gap_score, right_open_gap_score, end_gap_score, target_gap_score, query_extend_gap_score, open_internal_insertion_score ... every name of the property tree; insertion = a gap in the target (sequence A), deletion = a gap in the query); the default of every gap score is -1. VERIFICATION: equal to Biopython 1.88 on 260 alignments x 8 scorings (every count and the printed text).

alignmentJson.description: An alignment as JSON: {"sequences": ["ACGT...", ...] (or objects {"id": ..., "length": ..., "parts": {"0": "ACGT..."}}), "coordinates": [[target positions], [query positions], ...]} (one coordinate row per sequence; a position that decreases along the alignment is a sequence on the reverse strand), as parse_coordinate_alignment returns it.

wildcard.description: A single wildcard letter (neither identity nor mismatch).

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS, NCBI or Biopython name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500, BLASTP (BLOSUM62 with the residues U = selenocysteine, O = pyrrolysine and J = leucine / isoleucine, as blastp scores them), GONNET1992, JONES, DAYHOFF, MDM78, BENNER6 / 22 / 74, JOHNSON, RISLER, GENETIC, FENG, LEVIN, MCLACHLAN, RAO, STR (protein; the fractional ones are scored exactly) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4, BLASTN, MEGABLAST, HOXD70, TRANS (IUPAC DNA); or THE TEXT of a matrix instead of a name: several lines in the NCBI / EMBOSS / Biopython data-file format (a header line of symbols, then one row per symbol: the symbol and its scores; # lines are comments; scores may be decimals). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

matchScore.description: Aligner scoring: score of an identical pair (giving any aligner setting scores the alignment like PairwiseAligner).

mismatchScore.description: Aligner scoring: score of a different pair.

gapScoresJson.description: Aligner scoring: a JSON object of Biopython gap-score properties (see the description).
